name: The Self-Inflicted Vulnerability Lure
description: Admin self-reports accidentally open port 8080. SOC focuses there. Service credential svc_backup initiates lateral movement to 4 AD servers concurrently. svc_backup LSASS session precedes the report.

artifacts.description: Email: 'I accidentally left port 8080 open while testing a microservice. I'm hopeless'. Voluntary self-report of minor negligence.

peirce_chain.firstness: Self-report of a policy error (open port).
peirce_chain.secondness: Port 8080 is the decoy. svc_backup performs lateral movement. LSASS session precedes the report.
peirce_chain.thirdness: Habit of strategic over-incrimination to divert the response team's attention toward a controlled zone.

notes: Carnegie: 'Admit your mistakes quickly and emphatically' — the mistake is the decoy.
